findings.highlight: There’s no hesitation in those attacks.
findings.evidenceJa: そこに間断はなく
findings.governingReading: There is no interval or interruption between the attacks.
findings.explanation: Continuous tempo becomes a claim about psychological resolve.

findings.highlight: my shoulders are being crushed
findings.evidenceJa: 肩ごと左腕を砕かれたような感覚
findings.governingReading: the sensation that his left arm, shoulder and all, has been crushed
findings.explanation: A unilateral injury sensation becomes the crushing of both shoulders and drops the arm.

findings.highlight: I almost drop my swords.
findings.evidenceJa: 短剣を落としかける。
findings.governingReading: He nearly drops the shortsword.
findings.explanation: One affected hand and blade become both swords.

findings.highlight: the fist going for my temple
findings.evidenceJa: 眉間に繰り出される拳
findings.governingReading: the fist driven at the space between his brows
findings.explanation: The strike moves from the center of Shirou’s forehead to the side of his head.

findings.highlight: I pitifully retreat
findings.evidenceJa: なりふり構わず後退する俺
findings.governingReading: he retreats without concern for appearances or form
findings.explanation: Desperate disregard for form becomes a judgment that Shirou looks pathetic.

findings.highlight: Kuzuki closes in, not revealing any hints of how he advanced.
findings.evidenceJa: 前進した事も気づかせないまま間合いを詰める葛木
findings.governingReading: Kuzuki closes the interval without even allowing Shirou to notice that he advanced.
findings.explanation: A failure of perception becomes intentional concealment of technique.

findings.highlight: such hope disappeared after I took the first blow.
findings.evidenceJa: 思い違いは初撃で砕かれた。
findings.governingReading: the misconception was shattered by the opening strike
findings.explanation: mirror moon says the strike hit Shirou and vaguely ended hope, rather than destroying his tactical assumption.

findings.highlight: I can’t hope for high results
findings.evidenceJa: 高い完成度は望めない。
findings.governingReading: He cannot expect a high degree of completion in the improvised blade.
findings.explanation: A technical measure of Projection completeness becomes generic results.

findings.highlight: start to lose their precision.
findings.evidenceJa: 段々とその精度を落としていく。
findings.governingReading: The repeatedly improvised twin blades progressively decline in accuracy or fidelity.
findings.explanation: The progressive deterioration tied to repeated emergency Projection is weakened to an onset.

findings.highlight: I can’t breathe right.
findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸を殺しきれない。
findings.governingReading: He cannot fully suppress his breathing.
findings.explanation: Failure to silence his breath becomes general respiratory dysfunction.

findings.highlight: block Kuzuki’s fist with the shortswords.
findings.evidenceJa: 葛木の蛇に短剣を合わせる。
findings.governingReading: He matches his shortswords against Kuzuki’s “Snake.”
findings.explanation: The named fighting method is reduced to one fist, and a singular shortsword becomes plural.

findings.highlight: my precious Magic Circuits are disappearing one by one
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路が一つ消えていくような感覚
findings.governingReading: the sensation that one of his few Magic Circuits disappears with each sword
findings.explanation: A one-circuit-per-sword bodily cost becomes an ongoing plural disappearance and adds evaluative “precious.”

findings.highlight: I’ll die when my magical energy runs out.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力の貯蔵が失われた時がこちらの終わりだ。
findings.governingReading: His end comes when his capacity to store magical energy is lost.
findings.explanation: Loss of the body’s mana-storage function becomes ordinary depletion of current energy.

findings.highlight: Can I stay alive until my magical energy runs out?
findings.evidenceJa: あと二本使い切れる余裕など、この体のどこに
findings.governingReading: Where in this body is there enough reserve to use up even the last two blades?
findings.explanation: A question about bodily capacity to survive two more Projections becomes a question about lasting until mana depletion.

findings.highlight: The fist he hadn’t been using
findings.evidenceJa: 常に不動だったソレ
findings.governingReading: that right fist, which until then had remained perfectly motionless
findings.explanation: The tactical fact that the fist never moved becomes only non-use.

findings.highlight: I shielded my chest with my blades.
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を肋ごと貫こうとするその一撃
findings.governingReading: He receives on the twin blades a blow intended to pierce his chest together with his ribs.
findings.explanation: The intended penetrating anatomy and Kuzuki’s attacking agency disappear.

findings.highlight: pushed back about five meters
findings.evidenceJa: 弾き飛ばされた
findings.governingReading: knocked or hurled nearly five meters through the air
findings.explanation: A violent airborne launch into the wall becomes a push.

findings.highlight: has numbed my heart.
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓を麻痺させている。
findings.governingReading: has temporarily paralyzed his heart
findings.explanation: A medically and mechanically explicit cardiac stoppage becomes vague numbness.

findings.highlight: The devil approaches.
findings.evidenceJa: 幽鬼が迫る。
findings.governingReading: The ghost or specter closes in.
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s recurring ghostlike image becomes a theological monster.

findings.highlight: I’m not suited for melee combat.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は、そもそも剣を振るう人間じゃない。
findings.governingReading: He was never, fundamentally, a person who fights by wielding a sword.
findings.explanation: An identity distinction between swordsmanship and Magecraft becomes a general aptitude judgment about close combat.

findings.highlight: Emiya Shirou’s weapon has always been his magic.
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎が戦う武器は、初めから魔術と決まっている。
findings.governingReading: From the start, the weapon with which Emiya Shirou fights has been Magecraft.
findings.explanation: A technical and identity-bearing discipline is flattened to generic magic.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is also at a disadvantage.
findings.evidenceJa: 劣勢であるのは彼女も同じだった。
findings.governingReading: She too was at a disadvantage.
findings.explanation: The English removes the marked third-person viewpoint shift that begins Rin’s simultaneous battle.

findings.highlight: a witch that lived in the age of gods
findings.evidenceJa: 神代に生きた魔女
findings.governingReading: a witch who lived in the Age of Gods
findings.explanation: A setting term is rendered as an ordinary descriptive era rather than the named mythic age.

findings.highlight: surrounded by divine mysteries of ancient lore.
findings.evidenceJa: 歯車を回す神秘を帯びている。
findings.governingReading: she perpetually bears the Mystery that turns the world’s gears
findings.explanation: A functional metaphysical image becomes nonspecific ancient lore surrounding Caster.

findings.highlight: simple magic from the Magic Crest
findings.evidenceJa: 左手の魔術刻印による簡易詠唱
findings.governingReading: a simplified incantation through the Magic Crest on her left hand
findings.explanation: A casting procedure becomes a weaker type of magic, and the crest’s bodily location disappears.

findings.highlight: Crystallization of magical energy that she has stored since she was born as a magus.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師の娘として生を受け、今まで貯めに貯めてきた十年分以上の魔力の結晶。
findings.governingReading: crystals of more than ten years of magical energy, accumulated since she was born as a magus’s daughter
findings.explanation: The explicit duration and inherited family position disappear, while Rin herself is incorrectly said to have been born already a magus.

findings.highlight: you are doing well.
findings.evidenceJa: 健気に頑張ること。
findings.governingReading: How gallantly and devotedly you struggle.
findings.explanation: Caster’s patronizing appraisal of Rin’s brave persistence becomes neutral performance feedback.

findings.highlight: Caster can continue using magic indefinitely
findings.evidenceJa: ほぼ無限に魔術を行使できるキャスター
findings.governingReading: Caster can employ Magecraft in an almost inexhaustible quantity
findings.explanation: “Almost infinite” capacity is promoted to an unqualified indefinite duration and Magecraft is flattened.

findings.highlight: No matter how many jewels she might have, it cannot be more than ten or twenty.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女がどれほど宝石を所有しているかは知らぬが、所詮十や二十。
findings.governingReading: Caster does not know how many jewels Rin owns, but dismissively estimates ten or twenty at most.
findings.explanation: Caster’s limited, contemptuous estimate becomes an objective upper bound.

findings.highlight: You really are cute.
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に健気。
findings.governingReading: How admirably devoted of you.
findings.explanation: Caster’s patronizing praise of Rin’s earnest resistance becomes a comment on cuteness.

findings.highlight: Kuzuki should be protected by Caster, but he is an exception.
findings.evidenceJa: 葛木はキャスターによって護られているだろうが、彼だけは例外なのだ。
findings.governingReading: Kuzuki is probably protected by Caster, but Shirou alone is the exception to that protection.
findings.explanation: The English leaves “he” sounding like Kuzuki, obscuring that Shirou is the unprotected person who would burn.

findings.highlight: That is good faith
findings.evidenceJa: 大した信念ですけど
findings.governingReading: That is quite a conviction
findings.explanation: Caster’s mock respect for Rin’s resolve becomes the unrelated notion of good faith.

findings.highlight: The first one to run out of magical energy will die.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力が尽きた方が敗北する。
findings.governingReading: Whichever side exhausts its magical energy loses.
findings.explanation: Defeat in the magical contest is strengthened into literal death.

findings.highlight: You can’t use magic surpassing your own level.
findings.evidenceJa: 術者の許容量を上回る魔術は、決して使ってはならない
findings.governingReading: One must never use Magecraft that exceeds the practitioner’s capacity.
findings.explanation: An absolute bodily-capacity prohibition becomes an informal rule about abstract level.

findings.highlight: swallowed all of her magical energy inside of her robe
findings.evidenceJa: 衣の中に呑み込んだ
findings.governingReading: swallowed all the released magical energy into her garment
findings.explanation: The defensive image is awkwardly spatialized as energy already inside a robe rather than being absorbed into Caster’s garment.

findings.highlight: she can hear the sound of his defeat.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼が敗北を喫した音がしていた。
findings.governingReading: behind her came the sound of his defeat
findings.explanation: The simultaneous third-person narration is recast as Rin’s explicit auditory perception.

findings.highlight: even if she has a hundred jewels
findings.evidenceJa: 百の宝石を重ねても
findings.governingReading: even if she layered a hundred jewels together
findings.explanation: The hypothetical combined amplification of one hundred jewels becomes mere possession of them.

findings.highlight: you have value just because of that.
findings.evidenceJa: それだけでも貴女に価値を与えましょう
findings.governingReading: for that alone, I shall grant you some value
findings.explanation: Caster’s arrogated authority to confer worth on Rin becomes a statement that Rin inherently has value.

findings.highlight: holds in her nausea with her hand
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き気を手で押さえて
findings.governingReading: pressing a hand against the nausea rising in her
findings.explanation: The physical gesture of suppressing nausea is rendered as though nausea itself were grasped.

findings.highlight: She has been waiting for this.
findings.evidenceJa: その断定こそを、彼女はずっと待っていた。
findings.governingReading: That very certainty and declaration was what Rin had been waiting for.
findings.explanation: The exact trigger—Caster’s certainty that victory is complete—becomes an unspecified “this.”

findings.highlight: She only needs to say one phrase to release it.
findings.evidenceJa: 解放する呪文はただ一言。
findings.governingReading: The release incantation consists of only one word.
findings.explanation: The deliberate one-word limit becomes a potentially multiword phrase and is reframed as need rather than fact.

findings.highlight: Their battle of magic has ended with Tohsaka’s defeat.
findings.evidenceJa: 二人の魔術戦は、遠坂の敗北で終っていた。
findings.governingReading: To Shirou’s eyes, their magical battle had ended in Rin’s defeat.
findings.explanation: The past-tense observation within Shirou’s limited viewpoint reads as an unqualified completed outcome.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka charged in and attacked Caster!
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもなく気合いの入った姿勢で
findings.governingReading: Rin charged Caster in an outrageously committed fighting posture.
findings.explanation: The visually comic intensity that produces Shirou’s astonishment disappears.

findings.highlight: attacked Caster!
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターに殴りかかっていやがった！
findings.governingReading: she was actually launching herself at Caster with her fists
findings.explanation: The shocking switch from Magecraft to punching is reduced to a generic attack.

findings.highlight: she attacks Caster.
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターへと跳びかかった。
findings.governingReading: she leaps bodily upon Caster
findings.explanation: Rin’s airborne commitment through her own fire becomes a generic attack.

findings.highlight: a move from Chinese martial arts
findings.evidenceJa: 中国拳法でいうところの寸頸
findings.governingReading: the technique Chinese martial arts calls the one-inch strike
findings.explanation: The named close-range technique explaining Rin’s short chest blow disappears.

findings.highlight: self-defense is required knowledge
findings.evidenceJa: 護身術も必修科目よ
findings.governingReading: self-defense too is a required course
findings.explanation: The school-course joke about a modern magus’s practical curriculum becomes generic required knowledge.

findings.highlight: I’m fascinated by her combination.
findings.evidenceJa: 正直、惚れ惚れした。
findings.governingReading: Honestly, he cannot help but admire the beauty of the combination.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s colloquial, almost lovestruck admiration becomes clinical fascination.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka drops after the first attack.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の体が沈んだ。
findings.governingReading: Rin deliberately sinks her body low immediately after the short strike.
findings.explanation: A controlled level change sounds like Rin herself falls.

findings.highlight: She lashes out her foot with all her might
findings.evidenceJa: 体ごと回す旋脚
findings.governingReading: a wheeling sweep driven by the rotation of her whole body
findings.explanation: The full-body rotational mechanics become a generic forceful foot motion.

findings.highlight: cut off
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの足を蹴り折らんとばかりに
findings.governingReading: as though to kick Caster’s legs hard enough to break them
findings.explanation: The classic branch changes near-breaking force into leg amputation.

findings.highlight: “Take this…!”
findings.governingReading: “Fly…!”
findings.explanation: Rin’s command predicts and punctuates the launch produced by her punch; the English replaces it with a generic attack cry.

findings.highlight: punches with all her
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもなく腰の入った正拳
findings.governingReading: an extraordinary hip-driven straight punch
findings.explanation: The named straight punch and its hip mechanics become generic weight.

findings.highlight: Taking the punch directly
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の正拳突きをまともに受けた
findings.governingReading: taking Rin’s straight punch squarely
findings.explanation: The specific final technique is again reduced to an ordinary punch.

findings.highlight: her wound seems fatal.
findings.evidenceJa: あの様子では致命傷だろう。
findings.governingReading: judging from her condition, it is probably a fatal injury
findings.explanation: The basis in Caster’s overall observed condition narrows to one unspecified wound.

findings.highlight: executes her finishing blow.
findings.evidenceJa: とどめの一撃を見舞う。
findings.governingReading: closes in to deliver the finishing blow
findings.explanation: mirror moon presents the blow as executed even though Kuzuki interrupts before it can land.

findings.highlight: She challenged Caster at magic
findings.evidenceJa: あえて不利な魔術戦を演じたのか。
findings.governingReading: She deliberately performed a losing magical contest as bait.
findings.explanation: The intentional disadvantage and theatrical deception that enable the surprise attack disappear.

findings.highlight: like a hurricane, he ran like the devil’s wind
findings.evidenceJa: 疾風だとしたら、それは、魔風のような速度
findings.governingReading: if Rin was a gale, his speed was like a demonic wind
findings.explanation: A paired speed comparison becomes two literalized and inflated wind labels.

findings.highlight: jumps back, and shields herself… Kuzuki’s attack that blew me away
findings.evidenceJa: 咄嗟に顔を守って後ろに跳んだ瞬間、俺を吹き飛ばした右拳の一撃
findings.governingReading: the instant she guards her face and leaps back, the same right-fist blow that launched Shirou strikes
findings.explanation: The protected body part and continuity of Kuzuki’s right-fist technique disappear.

findings.highlight: her arms dangling as if broken.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の両手は、骨折したようにだらりと下げられていた。
findings.governingReading: both of Rin’s hands hang limp as though broken
findings.explanation: The apparent injury moves from both hands to the full arms.

findings.highlight: smashes into the wall opposite me
findings.evidenceJa: 正反対の壁際まで弾かれた
findings.governingReading: is flung as far as the wall on the side opposite Shirou
findings.explanation: The source places Rin at the opposite wall’s edge; the English asserts another direct wall impact.

findings.highlight: He speaks plainly.
findings.evidenceJa: 平然と言う。
findings.governingReading: He says it with complete composure.
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s unruffled affect becomes clarity of wording.

findings.highlight: Kuzuki’s ability
findings.evidenceJa: 卓越した格闘スキル
findings.governingReading: Kuzuki Souichirou’s outstanding close-combat skill
findings.explanation: The exact domain and exceptional degree of Kuzuki’s ability disappear.
